messages:
sara: Alert from synthetic: increased TLS resumption failures between ap-south and us-west after keystore sync window.
sara: Saw a correlated spike in KMS 'Decrypt' latency and 403s.
tom: grabbing logs — looks like session ticket unseal fails with key version mismatch: 'ticket_kid=ark-2026-v2' vs keystore active 'ark-2025-v9'.
navdeep: we rotated ARK wrapping key last night and replicated keys to ap-south; replication lag might have left nodes with stale key material.
eli: quick sample from edge-proxy logs:
```
[2026-03-20T04:10:12Z] edge-proxy-12 tls: session_resume failed: unseal_error: KMS: InvalidCiphertext; kid=ark-2026-v2; region=ap-south-1
[2026-03-20T04:10:12Z] keystore-3 unwrap: AccessDenied: missing keystore:replicate permission for principal=service/rotator@redwood
```
security_pm: customers: low-level API retries noticed but no major data loss. still need to avoid more user-facing spikes.
auditbot: automated find — unwrap events for key arn:aws:kms:...:key/ark-2026-v2 missing replication_tag metadata in 12 events; recommend enabling 'replica_id' indexing.
sara: two hypotheses: replication permissions (RBAC) or the rotator signed with new KID but didn't push replication manifest.
tom: rolling a quick check: `kubectl get replicaset keystore-replicas -n infra -o yaml | grep ark-2026` shows only 3/5 replicas have v2.
navdeep: root cause likely our KMS delegations restrict 'replicate' to role `keystore-replica-controller` which we recently tightened to limit by region. ap-south role binding may have been excluded.
eli: short-term mitigation: 1) allow keystore nodes to accept previous KID for 10m grace window; 2) add fallback to attempt remote unwrap in us-west if local unwrap fails with InvalidCiphertext.
security_pm: we should avoid allowing stale keys long-term. prefer fixing replication RBAC ASAP and add circuit-breaker for cross-region unwraps.
auditbot: note created — ticket #SEC-2026-421 (tags: keystore, replication, kms, session-resume).
sara: suggested immediate steps:
- patch rolebinding keystore-replica-controller to include `region:ap-south-1` (temp)
- enable `replica_id` in unwrap audit indexing
- enable kerror-based fallback to remote-wrap (us-west) for session ticket unseal
- add smoke test in rotation pipeline to validate replica count before promoting new KID
tom: kubectl patch suggestion:
```
kubectl patch clusterrolebinding keystore-replica-controller -p '{"subjects":[{"kind":"ServiceAccount","name":"replica-controller","namespace":"infra","labels":{"region":"ap-south-1"}}]}'
```
navdeep: PR incoming to rotation pipeline to require `kubectl wait --for=condition=ready --timeout=5m replicaset/keystore-replicas` before updating config.
eli: added a temporary guard in keystore: if unwrap fails with InvalidCiphertext and error contains 'KID mismatch', try `remote_unwrap(us-west)` with 2s timeout, increment metric `keystore.remote_unwraps`.
security_pm: agree to monitoring thresholds: if remote_unwraps > 1% of unwraps for 15m, trigger rollback of KID promotion.
sre_oncall: applying rolebinding patch now. will watch session_resume_success and KMS 403/InvalidCiphertext counts.
auditbot: change logged — replication_tag indexing enabled for decrypt events.
sara: after patch, partial recovery seen in ap-south zones. still tracking a couple of AZs with issues.
tom: follow-up: schedule a small postmortem to track docs updates: KMS delegation guide, rotation checklist (add replica-health gate), and add e2e for session ticket unseal in cross-region.
navdeep: will own rotation pipeline PR. tom will do the keystore RBAC follow-up. security_pm will lead postmortem.
sara: thanks all — keep thread updated if any customer escalations come through. going to leave the monitoring alarm open for 2 hours.
sre_oncall: patch applied, metrics trending back to baseline. closing in 90m if stable. :white_check_mark:
